fusions.name: Gnawing Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 5 gnawing bites in a wide spread, each dealing 3 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Devouring Pounce
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, and deals 20 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Full Belly
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
